industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: Enda Enerji Holding AS
summary: Enda Enerji Holding A.S. is comprehensively engaged in the renewable energy sector, handling the development, investment, ownership, operation, production, sale, and trading of related projects. The company's operational portfolio features ten power generation facilities, which collectively provide an installed capacity of 180.1 MWe. These assets specifically include four hydroelectric plants, five wind farms, and one geothermal power station, in addition to investments in biomass and solar energy. This enterprise was established in 1993 and operates from its base in Izmir, Turkey.
